references.text: Ezekiel describes a time of great distress and judgment over the people, which can be seen as a parallel to the great tribulation Jesus mentions.
Joel speaks of a day that is dark and full of despair, similar to the great tribulation Jesus refers to.
Jesus continues to describe events related to the great tribulation, including cosmic signs, which emphasize the seriousness and scope of this period.
The Revelation of John speaks of a great multitude coming out of the great tribulation, which directly connects to Jesus' words about a unique period of suffering.
